The Tin Mahawong Dynasty, also known as the Nan Dynasty or Nantharawong, was the second dynasty after the Phuka Dynasty to rule the Nan Kingdom. They ruled from 2269 BE (1726 CE) to 2474 BE (1931 CE), a total of 205 years, with 14 rulers.
Rulers of Nakhon Nan (1726–1931)
